unresolved_issues.message: Old normal-version mutex/segfault exits have no captured fault stack; repaired TLS startup race is not proven to be the same cause. Later passes do not establish causality.

classic-hover-03 could not obtain valid local position; log reports missing barometer. Same-config retry04 passed, but startup failure cause is not established. Recurred in corrected old-binary diagnostic before arming; not confined to classic controller.
4ms is an independent target, not an approved hard FAIL gate. Queue latency, downstream consumption and justified processing deadline remain unresolved; see latency-audit.json.
